nation.sentenceEn: This must begin with the question of how we maximise the health of the nation , rather than "fix" the NHS.

nuclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

nuclear.sentenceEn: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
nuclear.translationZh: 这家公司是新英格兰地区的主要能源供应商，上周它宣布要违背长期以来遵守该州严格核法规的承诺，这在佛蒙特州激起了无可非议的公愤。
nuclear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

necessity.sentenceEn: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity , says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
necessity.translationZh: 科罗拉多大学的鲍尔奇教授表示，与此同时，人们仍然将火灾视为一种需要全面控制的事件，只有在必要时才让其发生。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

necessity.sentenceEn: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
necessity.translationZh: 法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长与普及性，与20世纪汽车成为生活必备品的情况相提并论：当时法官们不得不为轿车这一新的个人领域制定全新规则；如今他们必须解决第四修正案如何适用于数字信息的问题。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

necessity.sentenceEn: Of necessity , colonial America was a projection of Europe.
necessity.translationZh: 必然地，殖民时期的美洲是欧洲的一种延伸。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

necessity.sentenceEn: To the men and women who served in World War II and the people they liberated, the G.I. was the common man grown into hero, the poor farm kid torn away from his home, the guy who bore all the burdens of battle, who slept in cold foxholes, who went without the necessities of food and shelter, who stuck it out and drove back the Nazi reign of murder.
necessity.translationZh: 对于那些曾在二战中服役的男女士兵以及他们解放的民众而言，G.I.是平凡人成长起来的英雄，是被迫背井离乡的贫苦农家子弟，是肩负战争重负、蜷缩在冰冷散兵坑、缺衣少食却依然坚守阵地、击退纳粹杀戮统治的战士。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

necessity.sentenceEn: It is entirely reasonable for auditors to believe that scientists who know exactly where they are going and how they will get there should not be distracted by the necessity of keeping one eye on the cash register while the other eye is on the microscope.
necessity.translationZh: 审计人员完全有理由认为，那些确切知道自己目标所在并清楚如何达成目标的科学家，不应因需要一只眼睛盯着收银机、另一只眼睛盯着显微镜而分心。
necessity.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

narrow.sentenceEn: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
narrow.translationZh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

narrow.sentenceEn: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
narrow.translationZh: 但在那些狭隘的兴趣圈子之外，有一片浩瀚的海洋正等待着人们去探索，那里充满了各种酝酿中的思想、智力上的冒险，以及想象力的洗礼。

narrow.sentenceEn: They cite past research by several authors to show that this is the gap that must be narrowed to close the achievement gap.
narrow.translationZh: 他们引用了多位学者过去的研究来表明，这正是缩小成就差距所必须填补的鸿沟。
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

narrow.sentenceEn: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that have narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
narrow.translationZh: 联邦巡回上诉法院的这一举措，紧随最高法院近期作出的一系列裁决之后，这些裁决已缩小了对专利持有人的保护范围。
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

narrow.sentenceEn: The three-fifths formula handed Jefferson his narrow victory in the presidential election of 1800 by inflating the votes of the southern states in the Electoral College.
narrow.translationZh: 五分之三妥协方案通过增加南方各州在选举人团中的票数，帮助杰斐逊在1800年总统选举中以微弱优势获胜。
narrow.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

narrow.sentenceEn: Narrowing your criteria, for example, may work against you: "Every time you answer a question you eliminate a possibility," says one expert.
narrow.translationZh: 例如，将搜索标准定得过窄可能会对你不利："每回答一个问题，你就排除了一种可能性，"一位专家说道。
narrow.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

necessarily.sentenceEn: Jokes that work on one person won't necessarily land with another.
necessarily.translationZh: 对某个人有效的笑话，不一定能打动另一个人。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第5句

necessarily.sentenceEn: Nothing is necessarily gained by forcing students to learn geometry at a graffitied desk stuck with generations of discarded chewing gum.
necessarily.translationZh: 强迫学生在一张布满涂鸦、沾满了几代人丢弃的口香糖的书桌上学习几何，未必能有什么收获。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

necessarily.sentenceEn: But it doesn't necessarily follow from findings like these that a world without work would be filled with unease.
necessarily.translationZh: 但是，我们不能仅凭这些发现就断定，一个没有工作的世界将会充满不安。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

necessarily.sentenceEn: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
necessarily.translationZh: 这未必是件坏事，但根据学校的不同，如果转专业太晚，补修学分的成本可能会很高。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

necessarily.sentenceEn: It doesn't then necessarily follow that one kind of reading is fuller, more advanced or more worthwhile than another.
necessarily.translationZh: 因此，我们不一定能得出某种阅读方式比另一种更全面、更高级或更有价值的结论。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

necessarily.sentenceEn: In plays, novels and narrative poems, characters speak as constructs created by the author, not necessarily as mouthpieces for the author's own thoughts.
necessarily.translationZh: 在戏剧、小说和叙事诗中，人物的语言是作者塑造的角色表达，而非必然是作者个人思想的传声筒。

notion.sentenceEn: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term "plant neurobiology" was coined around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be compared to intelligence in animals.
notion.translationZh: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早在21世纪初开始扎根；"植物神经生物学"这一术语的创造正是基于这样一种概念，即植物行为的某些方面可以与动物的智力相比较。
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

notion.sentenceEn: It can catch someone's attention in a crowded room, "Eye contact and smile" can signal availability and confidence, a common-sense notion supported in studies by psychologist Monica Moore.
notion.translationZh: 在拥挤的房间里，眼神交流可以吸引他人的注意；而“眼神交流配合微笑”则能传递出乐于交往和自信的信号——心理学家莫妮卡·摩尔的研究也证实了这一常识性观点。
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

notion.sentenceEn: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
notion.translationZh: 更理想的做法是帮助提升美的概念，使其超越特定行业的物质标准。
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

notion.sentenceEn: It's time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says.
notion.translationZh: 黑格尔认为，现在是时候重新制定工作方式的规则了，因为我们仍然依赖着一套非常 20 世纪的工作理念。
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

notion.sentenceEn: For example, notions of evidence and fact, of basic rights and public interest are at work in the process of journalistic judgment and production just as in courts of law.
notion.translationZh: 例如，证据与事实、基本权利与公共利益等概念，在新闻判断和新闻制作过程中发挥的作用，与它们在法庭上的作用并无二致。
notion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

notion.sentenceEn: While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories, it is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.
notion.translationZh: 尽管律师的评论和反馈可能会提升报道质量，但记者最好还是依靠自己对重要性的理解并做出独立判断。
notion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
notion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

newly.sentenceEn: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people."
newly.translationZh: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确指出：“我们认识到时尚产业对体型理想，尤其是对年轻人的影响，并对此承担责任。”
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

newly.sentenceEn: Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.
newly.translationZh: 去问问那些刚失业的人想要什么，答案永远是：一份工作。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

newly.sentenceEn: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
newly.translationZh: 乍一听，这似乎是一位心系社会的财政大臣，试图改善人们的生活，并对一个明显纵容的体系进行"改革"——该体系对新失业者找工作的努力要求过低，实则助长了懒惰。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

newly.sentenceEn: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
newly.translationZh: 不足为奇的是，新发表的发现声明以及看似重要且令人信服的可靠发现，总会面临未来研究者的质疑，并有可能被修正或驳斥。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

newly.sentenceEn: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
newly.translationZh: 这与新标桩的采矿权相似，充满了潜力。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

newly.sentenceEn: There are also stories about newly adoptive – and newly single – mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual "Jennifer Aniston is pregnant" news.
newly.translationZh: 杂志上还有关于刚领养孩子、且刚恢复单身的母亲桑德拉·布洛克的报道，以及常见的“詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了”之类的新闻。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

navigate.sentenceEn: Prehistoric humans may have tamed donkeys to help navigate the expanding Sahara.
navigate.translationZh: 史前人类可能已经驯化了驴，以帮助他们在不断扩大的撒哈拉沙漠中穿行。
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

navigate.sentenceEn: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
navigate.translationZh: AI 具备简化职场生活、处理行政琐事并提升工作体验的潜力，而我们也应审慎地引导其应用，确保它在提供支持的同时，不会危及我们的隐私。
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

navigate.sentenceEn: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
navigate.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许学生们在校园中心的椭圆形草坪（the Oval）自由穿行，随后学校将这些学生们自然踩出的小径铺设成路，形成了一张由学生自行开辟的高效路线网络。
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

navigate.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
navigate.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

navigate.sentenceEn: If you get lost without a phone or a compass, and you literally can't find north, we have a few tricks to help you navigate back to civilization, one of which is to follow the land.
navigate.translationZh: 如果你迷了路，既没有手机也没有指南针，而且真的找不到北，我们有几个技巧可以帮助你回到文明世界，其中之一就是顺着地形走。
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

navigate.sentenceEn: So how do we navigate this?
navigate.translationZh: 那么我们该如何应对这种情况呢？
navigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

nowadays.sentenceEn: There has been a kind of inflationary process at work: nowadays anyone applying for a research post has to have published twice the number of papers that would have been required for the same post only 10 years ago.
nowadays.translationZh: 某种通货膨胀式的过程正在上演：如今申请研究职位的人必须发表的论文数量，是10年前同一职位要求的两倍。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays , his reading material has changed from science fiction and reference books: recently, he revealed that he reads at least 50 nonfiction books a year.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，他的阅读材料已不再是科幻小说和参考书：最近，他透露自己每年至少阅读50本非虚构类书籍。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

nowadays.sentenceEn: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish. I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays , statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says, but he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
nowadays.translationZh: 他表示：“大多数期刊在统计审查方面较为薄弱，这损害了它们发表内容的质量。我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为关键。”但他也指出，像《内科医学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊对统计审查给予了高度重视。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays the number of births, like the age of death, has become average.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，新生儿的数量如同死亡年龄一样，已经趋于平均化。
nowadays.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Additional social stresses may also occur because of the population explosion or problems arising from mass migration movements—themselves made relatively easy nowadays by modern means of transport.
nowadays.translationZh: 此外，人口爆炸或大规模迁移所引发的问题也可能带来新的社会压力——而现代交通工具的发展使得大规模迁移变得相对容易。
nowadays.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

nowadays.sentenceEn: For example, in the early industrialized countries of Europe the process of industrialization—with all the far-reaching changes in social patterns that followed—was spread over nearly a century, whereas nowadays a developing nation may undergo the same process in a decade or so.
nowadays.translationZh: 例如，在欧洲早期工业化国家，工业化进程——及其带来的所有深远社会结构变革——持续了近一个世纪，而如今一个发展中国家可能只需十年左右就能完成同样的过程。
nowadays.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句
